margin_framing.first_stated_note: Framework dates from Investor Day 2022 (doc 93215, date not loaded in Baba); earliest fetched restatement in window 2025-05-01

street.gap_assumption: December year end, Baba FY labels equal calendar years. No stated level or year, so the framework is projected: FY2026 guided adjusted operating margin 15.2% ($3.5B AOP / ~$23B sales, doc 107396) plus 50 bps a year to FY2028 = 16.2%, versus VA consensus FY2028 operating margin 16.97% (FY2027 16.27%). Consensus already sits above the framework.

evidence_of_progress.note: Order is [Q1 2026, Q2 2026]. Q1 2026 adjusted operating margin 11.1% vs 16.3% (VA actuals $594M/$5,341M vs $848M/$5,218M). Q2 2026 17.2% (Goris, doc 107396) vs 19.1% in Q2 2025 (VA). Guided FY2026 margin about 15.2%, roughly flat on FY2025 15.1%; 2H 2026 AOP guided up about 50% YoY. VA has not loaded Q2 2026 actuals, so LTM EBITDA margin uses Q2 2025 to Q1 2026.

disqualifier_reason: Margin framework already reflected in consensus: 50 bps a year from the ~15.2% FY2026 guide gives ~16.2% in FY2028, 75 bps BELOW VA consensus operating margin of 16.97%. The portfolio transformation closed in 2024 (outside 18 months) and there is no CEO or CFO change (Gitlin CEO since 2020-04-01; Goris CFO since 2020-11-16).
verdict: Not a GXO setup: cheap after a 32% drawdown, but long-tenured management, an evergreen 50 bps a year framework with no end year, and a street that already models faster margin recovery than the framework.
open_questions: Will Carrier restate the over 50 bps a year margin framework for 2027 given flat 2026 margins and dilutive data center commercial mix?
What year does 'mid-teen operating margins over the next few years' for Climate Solutions Europe under new president Thomas Donato refer to?
Is consensus FY2027 operating margin of 16.27% (+100 bps on the 2026 guide) too high if commercial and data center mix keeps diluting margins?
